summary.text: Todd Johnson is the Republican candidate for Pennsylvania State Senate District 4 in the November 3, 2026 general election, a rematch against incumbent Democrat Art Haywood.
Ballotpedia lists him as having worked as a pastor.

paragraphs.text: Todd Johnson first ran for the seat in 2022, winning the Republican primary and then losing the general election to Haywood, who received 85.0 percent of the vote to Johnson's 15.0 percent.
He again won the Republican primary on May 19, 2026, unopposed.
